subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Which native backup exclude semantics should OpenClaw support without making backups unrestorable or weakening sensitive-file handling?
rationale: The remaining work adds CLI surface and chooses default/protected backup scope for local state, credentials, plugins, and workspaces, which is a product and security tradeoff rather than a narrow mechanical repair.

options.title: Rework native exclusions
options.body: Review or replace the linked native PR with restore-safe defaults, protected-path handling, docs, tests, and real large-state proof.

options.title: Keep native scope minimal
options.body: Leave core backup behavior mostly as-is and document plugin backup options, accepting that this native CLI limitation remains open or explicitly rejected.

options.title: Split explicit and default behavior
options.body: Consider an explicit `--exclude`/`--exclude-file` path first while deferring smart defaults and protected-path override policy to narrower follow-up review.

recommendation.title: Rework native exclusions
recommendation.body: Review or replace the linked native PR with restore-safe defaults, protected-path handling, docs, tests, and real large-state proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently landed backup reliability hardening and are the best available routing candidate for the restore-safety/security default decision.
